sinful, impure, BhP.

a: अघ — a. [अघ्-कर्तरि अच्] Bad, sinful, evil, wicked; अघायुरिंद्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति Bg. 3. 16. --घं [अघ् भावे अच्] 1 Sin; अघं स केवलं भुंक्ते यः पचत्यात्मकारणात् Ms. 3. 118, Bg. 3. 13; अघौघविध्वंसविधौ पटीयसींः Śi. 1. 18, 26; ˚मर्षण &c.; misdeed, fault, crime; श्रेयान् द्विजातिरिव हंतुमघानि दक्षं Śi. 4. 37 sins and griefs also. --2 An evil, mishap, misfortune, accident, injury, harm; न वधूष्वघानि विमृशंति धियः Ki. 6. 45 do not think of doing harm or evil; क्रियादघानां मघवा विघातं 3. 52, 11. 80; प्रजानां तमघावहं R. 15. 51, 19. 52, See अनघ. --3 Impurity (अशौचं); अनुरुध्यादघं त्र्यहं Ms. 5. 63; न राज्ञामघदोषोस्ति 93; न वर्धयेदघाहानि 84. --4 Pain, suffering, grief, distress; दयालुमनघस्पृष्टं R. 10. 19 not subject to grief. --5 Passion. --घः N. of a demon, brother of Baka and Pūtanā and commander-in-chief of Kaṃsa. [Being sent by Kaṃsa to Gokula to kill Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma he assumed the form of a huge serpent {4} yojanas long, and spread himself on the way of the cowherds, keeping his horrid mouth open. The cowherds mistook it for a mountain cavern and entered it, cows and all. But Kṛṣṇa saw it, and having entered the mouth so stretched himself that he tore it to pieces and rescued his companions.] --घा The Goddess of sin; (pl.) the constellation usually called Maghā. --Comp. --असुरः See अघ above. --अहः (अहन्) a day of impurity (अशौच दिनं). --आयुस् a. leading a wicked life. --कृत् a. sinful, wicked, evildoer. --घ्नः = ˚नाशन. --नाश, --नाशन a. [अघं नाशयति] expiatory, destroying sin (such as gifts, muttering holy prayers &c.). --(नः) destroyer of the demon अघ; N. of Kṛṣṇa. --भोजिन् a. [अघं पापफलकं भुंक्ते] a sinful eater (one who cooks and eats for his own sake and not for Gods, Manes guests &c). --मर्षण a. [अघं मृष्यते उत्पन्नत्वेपि नाशनेन कर्माक्षमत्वात् सह्यते अनेन मृष्-ल्युट्] expiatory, removing or destroying sin, usually applied to a prayer repeated by Brāhmaṇas (the 190th hymn of Rv. 10.); सर्वैनसामपध्वंसि जप्यं त्रिष्वघमर्षणं Ak.; यथाश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः . तथाघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापप्रणाशनं ... The most heinous crimes, such as illicit intercourse with a preceptor's wife, one's own mother, sister, daughterin-law &c, are said to be expiated by repeating this सूक्त thrice in water; पवित्राण्यघमर्षणानि जपंत्यां K. 179, 38. --मार a. [अघं मारयति नाशयति; मृ णिच्-अण्] destroying sin, an epithet of Gods (यमो मृत्युरघमारो निरृतः). --रुद् a. [अघं रोदिति स्वकर्माक्षमतया यस्मात्, रुद-अपादाने क्विप्] {1} ‘making sin weep and fly’, N. of a Mantra which destroys sin; fearfully howling (?). {2} [अघे व्यसने रोदिति न तत्प्रतीकाराय घटते, क्विप्] one who only weeps in times of calamity, but does not try to get over them. --विषः [अघं व्यसनकारि विषं यस्य] a serpent; fearfully venomous (?). --शंसः [अघस्य शंसः; शंस् भावे अच्] {1} indication or reporting of sin. {2} [अघं अनिष्टं शंसति इच्छति; शंस्-अण्] a wicked man, such as a thief. {3} wicked; sin-destroying (?). --शंसिन् a. reporting or telling one's sin or guilt. --हारः a noted robber; rumour of guilt (?).

tri, (aGaM pApaM mfzyate utpannatve'pi nASanena karmmAkzamatvAt sahyate'nena aGa + mfz + karaRelyuw .) pApanASanaM । sarvvapApaDvaMsijapyaM । ityamaraH ॥ (utpannapApanASArTaM japye mantraBede yaTA sanDyAmantre drupadAdivetyAdi) aSvameDayajYANgAvaBfTasnAnamantraH । vEdikasanDyAntargatamantrakaraRakAGrAtajalaprakzeparUpapApanASakakriyAviSezaH । iti smftiH ॥ tAntrikasanDyAyAntu, -- “zaqaNganyAsamAcaryya vAmahaste jalaM tataH । gfhItvA dakziRenEva saMpuwaM kArayedbuDaH ॥ SivavAyujalapfTvIvahnivIjEstriDA punaH । aBimantrya ca mUlena saptaDA tattvamudrayA ॥ niHkzipet tajjalaM mUrdDni SezaM dakze niDAya ca । iqayAkfzya dehAntaHkzAlitaM pApasaYcayaM ॥ kfzRavarRaM tadudakaM dakzanAqyA virecayet । dakzahaste ca tanmantrI pAparUpaM vicintya ca ॥ purato vajrapAzARe nikzipedastramuYcaran” ॥ iti tantrasAraH ॥

sUktaYca । tacca antarjale japyam tatPalaYcoktaM brAhmaRasarvasve । yaTA “bODAyanaH “ftaYca satyaYcAdyaGamarzaRam trirantarjale japan sarvasmAt pApAt pramucyate” । yogiyAjYavalkyaH “hatvA lokAnimAMstrIn hi triH paWedaGamarzaRam । yaTASvameDAbaBfTamevaM tanmanurabravIt” iti । hArItaH “pAtakopapAtakamahApAtakAnAmekatamasannipAte'GamarzaRameva japet” iti । bfhadvizRuH “yaTASvameDaH kraturAw sarvapApApanodanaH । taTAGamarzaRaM sUktaM sarvapApapraRASanam” iti । yogiyAjYavalkyaH “snAnamabdEvatErmantrErmArjanaM prARasaMyamaH । aGamarzaRasUktena aSvameDAvaBftsamam” iti । SaNKaH “jalanimagnaH prARAn saMyamya trirAvfttAGamarzaRasUktena snAyAt nAstyaGamarzaRAt paramantarjjale” iti । gOtamaH “antarjale'GamarzaRaM trirAvarttayan sarvapApeByo mucyate” iti । atriH “api cApsu nimajjitvA triH paWedaGamarzaRam । yaTASvameDAvaBfTaM taTEtanmanurabravIt” iti । vaSizWaH “api cApsu nimajjAnaH triH paWedaGamarzaRam । yaTASvameDAvaBfTaM tAdfSaM manurabravIt” iti । ApastambaH “api cApsu nimajjitvA triH paWedaGamarzaRam” । yaTASvameDayajYo hi manustAdfSamAha tat” iti । bODAyanaH “trirAtraM cApyupavasan trirahnAByupayannapaH । prARAnambuni saMyamya triH paWedaGamarzaRam । “yaTASvameDAvaBfTamevaM tanmanurabravIt” iti । yogiyAjYavalkyaH “tryahaM copavased yastu trirahnoByupayannapaH । mucyate pAtakEH sarvEH japtvA triraGamarzaRam” iti । rahasye bfhanmanuH “mAtaraM BaginIM gatvA mAtfsvasAraM snuzAM saKIM sanAByAYca agamyAgamanaM kftvA aGamarzaRam antarjale trirAvartya etasmAt pApAt pUto BavatIti” । taTA “gurutalpagamanaM kftvA aGamarzaRamantarjjale trirAvartya etasmAt pApAt pUto BavatIti” । atra pApagOravamAkalayya saMyatena mAsyekaM yAvat jalamavagAhyAGamarzaRasUktaM trirAvartya snAtavyam । taTA ca laGuyamaH “mahApAtakakarttAraScatvAraSca viSezataH । agniM praviSya SudDyanti snAtvA vAGa iti kratO । rahasyakaraRe cEva mAsamaByasya pOruzam । aGamarzaRaYca vA sUktaM SuDyeccAntarjalesTitaH” iti । bfhadyamaH “aTa brahmahatyAM kftvA prAcIM vA udIcIM vA diSamupanizkramya praBUtenenDanenAgniM prajvAlyAGamarzaRaM cAzwasahasramAvartya juhuyAt tasmAt pApAt pUto BavatIti” । hArItaSca “antarjjale trirAvartya mucyate brahmahatyayeti” । vfdDApastambaH “akAryyakaraRe cEva aBakzyasya ca BakzaRe । aGamarzaRasUktena pItvApaH SuDyate naraH” । vaSizWaH “manasA pApaM kftvA aGamarzaRaM japet” iti । vfdDApastambaH “kzatriyAgamane vESyAgamane cEva tApasIm । trirAvartya viSudDaH syAt SUdrAgAmyaGamarzaRam” iti । tApasImiti tApasIm fcamityarTaH SaNKaliKitO “brahmahA “trirAtropozito'ntarjale'GamarzaRaM trirAvarttayet” iti । yAjYavalkyaH trirAtropozitojaptvA brahmahA tvaGamarzaRam । antarjale viSudDyettu dattvA gAntu payasvinIm” iti । prakASavizaye bODAyanaH “tIrTaM gatvA tataH SucirAtmA udakAnte sTaRqile udDftya sakfcCinnavAsasA sakft pUrRena pARinA AdityABimuKaH aGamarzaRamaDyAyamaDIyIta iti” । zaqaNganyAsaM kftvA vAmahaste jalaM niDAya dakziRahastena jalamAcCAdya haM yaM raM laM vaM iti triraBimantrya mUlamuccaran galitodakavindu BistatvamudrayA saptaDA mUrdDAnamaByukzya SezajalaM dakziRahaste samAdAya tejorUpaM DyAtvA iqayAkfzya dehAntaHpApaM prakzAlya kfzRavarRaM tajjalaM DyAtvA piNgalayA virecya puraH kalpitavajraSilAyAM Paqiti mantreRa pApapuruzasvarUpaM tajjalaM niHkzipedityaGarzaRam iti tantrasAre tAntrikAGamarzaRamuktam tatpramARaM tu tatrEvAvagamyam ।
